task_completion.description: Log into the wger application using admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the wger dashboard or a 'Logged in as admin' message after the login screen.

task_completion.description: Create a new workout routine named 'Smolov Jr. Bench'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A routine detail page or list showing the name 'Smolov Jr. Bench' exactly.

task_completion.description: Add 4 distinct training days to the routine.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The routine view showing four separate day entries or headers (e.g., Day 1, Day 2, Day 3, Day 4).

task_completion.description: Configure Day 1 with Bench Press: 6 sets of 6 reps.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of 'Bench Press' under Day 1 with '6 × 6' or '6 Sets, 6 Reps' displayed.

task_completion.description: Configure Day 2 with Bench Press: 7 sets of 5 reps.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of 'Bench Press' under Day 2 with '7 × 5' or '7 Sets, 5 Reps' displayed.

task_completion.description: Configure Day 3 with Bench Press: 8 sets of 4 reps.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of 'Bench Press' under Day 3 with '8 × 4' or '8 Sets, 4 Reps' displayed.

task_completion.description: Configure Day 4 with Bench Press: 10 sets of 3 reps.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of 'Bench Press' under Day 4 with '10 × 3' or '10 Sets, 3 Reps' displayed.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation or API scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with buttons, forms, and menus within the wger browser UI.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to bypass the UI for routine creation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is not used for anything other than perhaps starting the browser; no curl commands or SQL scripts are visible.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the wger menus to reach the workout section.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from the dashboard to the 'Workout' or 'Routine' management sections.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The routine must be named 'Smolov Jr. Bench'. It must contain exactly 4 days. Each day must have the 'Bench Press' exercise. The specific set/rep requirements are: Day 1 (6x6), Day 2 (7x5), Day 3 (8x4), and Day 4 (10x3). Verify these numbers appear correctly in the final routine summary.
